newsitem.title: USA: Samsung wins Korean OK for AST purchase.
newsitem.headline: Samsung wins Korean OK for AST purchase.

text.p: Samsung Electronics Co. Ltd said on Monday it had won all necessary approvals from the Korean government to complete its acquisition of computer maker AST Research Inc.

Samsung had extended its $5.40 per share, or $170 million, tender offer for the shares of AST it did not already own while it awaited the approvals. The offer, launched in January, was extended on July 22.
As of July 21, Samsung said approximately 88 percent of the outstanding shares had been tendered.
It said all other conditions to the offer have been satisfied and the tender offer and withdrawal rights will expire at 5 p.m. EDT on Friday, Aug. 8.
AST's shares gained 12.5 cents to $5.3125 in early trading on Nasdaq.
